purpose: Source-by-source scope audit for H1 (FB1) and H2 (RC3 phi4_4), per Iteration-3 mandate.

H1_FB1_sources.citation: Ya. G. Sinai, 'On the foundations of the ergodic hypothesis for a dynamical system of statistical mechanics', Dokl. Akad. Nauk SSSR 153, 1261 (1963); later rigorous hard-sphere gas results (e.g. Chernov, Ann. Math. 149, 645 (1999) family).
H1_FB1_sources.establishes: Rigorous ergodic/mixing results for specific mechanical system classes (Sinai billiards, hard-sphere gas under stated conditions).
H1_FB1_sources.exact_relevance: Provides a demonstrated mechanism (chaotic mixing) by which microcanonical-type statistical behavior emerges for RESTRICTED systems.
H1_FB1_sources.limitation: No universal theorem over generic many-body systems; conditions (finite N, hard-core/short-range, no integrals besides energy, etc.) are explicit; does not produce the equal-a-priori MEASURE itself in general -- measure justification still relies on typicality/equal-prior inputs or finite-time mixing approximations.

H1_FB1_sources.citation: Goldstein, Lebowitz, Tumulka, Zanghi, Phys. Rev. Lett. 96, 050403 (2006) (and related typicality literature).
H1_FB1_sources.establishes: Concentration of microcanonical expectation values on the typicality sphere for large systems.
H1_FB1_sources.exact_relevance: Shows typicality can justify equal weights over the microcanonical shell.
H1_FB1_sources.limitation: Typicality is itself a postulate over the shell (uniform measure); it re-locates rather than derives the statistical input. Does not apply away from microcanonical structure.

H1_FB1_sources.citation: Generic statistical mechanics as claimed by edge FB1v2 (pilot/iter2).
H1_FB1_sources.establishes: NOTHING without an imported statistical postulate outside the demonstrated mixing classes.
H1_FB1_sources.exact_relevance: Confirms the imported-postulate dependency survives for the GENERIC claim.

H2_RC3_phi4_sources.establishes: Rigorous triviality of the continuum phi^4 theory for d > 4 (five or more dimensions).
H2_RC3_phi4_sources.exact_relevance: Demonstrates a UV-candidate class can be rendered trivial in some dimensions -- concept relevant to UV non-uniqueness/indeterminacy.
H2_RC3_phi4_sources.limitation: Does NOT constitute the same theorem at d=4.

H2_RC3_phi4_sources.citation: J. Frohlich, Helv. Phys. Acta 56, 705 (1983) (and related).
H2_RC3_phi4_sources.establishes: Rigorous triviality results for phi^4 in d > 4 (with refinements).
H2_RC3_phi4_sources.limitation: d=4 remains outside the rigorous theorem.

H2_RC3_phi4_sources.citation: Lattice phi^4 studies (e.g. Luscher & Weisz, Nucl. Phys. B 290 [FS20], 25 (1987); subsequent lattice analyses).
H2_RC3_phi4_sources.establishes: Strong NUMERICAL/LATTICE_EVIDENCE that phi^4_4 is trivial (no nontrivial continuum fixed point at d=4).
H2_RC3_phi4_sources.exact_relevance: Supporting context that the classical perturbative phi^4_4 UV candidate is likely trivial.
H2_RC3_phi4_sources.limitation: Not a rigorous continuum theorem at d=4.

H2_RC3_phi4_sources.citation: K. G. Wilson, Rev. Mod. Phys. 47, 773 (1975).
H2_RC3_phi4_sources.establishes: The Wilsonian RG framework; the RG coarse-grains and discards information about couplings irrelevant at low energy.
H2_RC3_phi4_sources.exact_relevance: Directly supports line B of RC3: EFT data constrain but do not determine the UV theory (multiple UV theories can share the same IR EFT).
H2_RC3_phi4_sources.limitation: Framework-level argument; non-uniqueness shown by construction/multiplicity, not a single exhaustive theorem over ALL UV completions.

H2_RC3_phi4_sources.establishes: Enormous multiplicity of (metastable) vacua in flux compactifications -- many vacua over a low-energy EFT region.
H2_RC3_phi4_sources.exact_relevance: Concrete demonstration that a given low-energy effective structure is compatible with vastly many distinct UV completions.
H2_RC3_phi4_sources.limitation: Framework-relative (string landscape); not a theorem about all possible UV physics.

H2_RC3_phi4_sources.citation: M. R. Douglas, S. Kachru, Rev. Mod. Phys. 79, 733 (2007).
H2_RC3_phi4_sources.establishes: Review of flux compactification vacuum multiplicity.

H2_RC3_phi4_sources.citation: Standard EFT matching/order-counting (Wilson; Weinberg, Physica A 96, 327 (1979)).
H2_RC3_phi4_sources.establishes: An EFT at order N cannot distinguish UV structures differing only in contributions first appearing at order N+1 and beyond.
H2_RC3_phi4_sources.scope: CONCEPTUAL_RG_ARGUMENT / structural (follows from the EFT construction)
H2_RC3_phi4_sources.exact_relevance: Directly supports line A: finite-order EFT data is finite-dimensional information and cannot pin a unique UV completion.
H2_RC3_phi4_sources.limitation: In-principle argument; does not by itself quantify how much UV freedom is retained at each order.
